items.text: Bhayshul Tuten (JAX) had 12 of Jacksonville's 27 rushes vs HOU, 44 percent, a week after 22 of 24 back carries, and Chris Rodriguez Jr. ran 11 times for 55. His two receiving TDs hid the carry drop. He is RB18 rest of season for me. Hold him through the Week 7 bye; this is no longer a buy.
items.why: The Week 8 carry split decides it: back over 60 percent of the rushes makes him a buy again, another near-even split makes him a sell.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson (NE) played through the ankle vs NYJ, with 7 carries for 31 on 16 snaps and a lost fumble, so the multi-week absence did not happen. Rhamondre Stevenson still led the backs. Henderson is RB26 rest of season for me. Monitor his snap share @CHI Thursday night.

Jalen Hurts (PHI): testing found a deep vein thrombosis and clots in both lungs, he is on blood thinners with no contact allowed, and he is expected to miss the rest of the season. That is the trigger from Saturday's hold. Tanner McKee went 26 of 45 for 215 vs CAR. Drop Hurts in redraft.

Josh Jacobs (GB) came off the Commissioner's Exempt List Monday, is eligible for Week 7 @DET and is expected to start. The NFL's review of his case is still open. He is RB37 rest of season for me. Hold him; the call changes if the league suspends him when the review closes.
items.why: The call changes if the league suspends him when its review closes.

items.text: Cam Skattebo (NYG) played 6 snaps with no touches vs NO, a week after his fourth lost fumble, and John Harbaugh said someone needs to step up and be the back. Tyrone Tracy Jr. scored twice on 8 touches. Hold Skattebo until Wednesday's practice report and the Week 7 depth chart at HOU say who leads.
items.why: Wednesday's practice report and the Week 7 depth chart decide it; a second game under 15 snaps @HOU makes him a sell.

items.why: Spears out-snapping him again would reopen the sell.
